resources.string: Lets Alton read the rota on your shift app\'s screen when you ask it to add your shifts. It only reads while Alton has opened that app for you, and nothing leaves your phone except the rota text you ask about.
Alton: greeting, next shift, next reminder, and Talk / Drive buttons
